question: What public finance enabled the majority investment?
finding: Finance Ministry facility to ZCCM-IH is linked by the completion filing to Glencore covenant settlement and Delta entry. Only the separate USD15m upfront payment is labeled paid.
missing_bridge: No full drawdown/repayment ledger proves disbursement of the entire facility. No evidence funds were paid to an ultimate natural-person owner.

question: Which institution financed or guaranteed which project layer?
finding: License, borrower, equity vehicle and guarantor are separate documented roles.
missing_bridge: Equity amounts unreconciled; loan disbursement and guarantee calls not established. No sale of incumbent established.

question: Does a manager owner personally receive fund investment?
finding: Investor-to-fund and person-to-manager relationships are documented separately.
missing_bridge: No transfer to the person, ultimate ownership of portfolio assets or reconciled invested cash amount.

question: Does the charitable pledge establish asset ownership or personal benefit?
finding: Pledge and chair role are documented.
missing_bridge: Neither is evidence of ownership of recipient, personal payment or implementation expenditure.
